description: This file defines a custom Doctrine ORM function 'TimeDiff' that calculates the difference between two date/time expressions in specified units ('minute', 'hour', or default) using SQL functions. It extends the Doctrine FunctionNode to parse and generate appropriate SQL for use within Doctrine queries.

classes.name: TimeDiff
classes.description: A custom Doctrine ORM function node class for calculating time differences in various units.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the arguments of the TimeDiff function from the Doctrine query and assigns them to class properties.

methods.name: getSql
methods.description: Generates the SQL string representing the time difference calculation based on the provided type ('minute', 'hour', or default).
